title: Concept: Profile repository that allows snapshot updates
description: settings.xml declares a profile repository with snapshots enabled, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a profile repository with snapshots enabled.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.xml (maven).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a profile repository with snapshots enabled.
